panel_1734178809.name: AppealPanels

guidetextdraw._value: Appeals are only considered for extraordinary circumstances beyond the applicant’s control and must contain new and compelling information not initially presented in the application. In order for the appeal to have merit, it must be complete, and supporting documentation is required. Appeals must be submitted within 15 days after the initial receipt of your original admission decision from the Office of Admissions. We will notify you within 30 days from the date of your submission of a final decision.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1743148341471

guidetextdraw._value:
Application Fee Wavier Instructions

  • Fill, sign, and attach the CSU Application Fee Wavier form 
  • In your personal statement, detail the change in income & circumstances.
  • Provide a copy of a recent pay stub, if available, which includes year-to-date earnings.
  • Include other documents as appropriate to support your request
guidetextdraw.name: FeeText

guidetextdraw._value:
Note :

  • In order to be considered for an admissions appeal, you must include supporting documentation. This may include, but is not limited to: unofficial transcripts, unofficial test scores, ADT Verification, ADT awarded with degree date posted on transcript, work in progress reports, etc.
  • Only PDF, JPEG, PNG, JPG, TIF, TIFF files are allowed.
